text.title: Laravel PHPUnit / Pest Examples
text.summary: Worked example: a unit test for OrderService built from per-test factories, AAA structure, a data provider and constructor-injected mocks — no framework boot.

example.context: Laravel 11 with PHPUnit 11. `OrderService::calculateTotal($items)` returns a `Money` value and must cover four edge cases: empty basket, single line, discount applied, mixed currency.
example.walk: Step 1: `tests/Unit/Services/OrderServiceTest.php` extends `PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase` — no Laravel boot. Step 2: a data builder produces the `OrderItem` stubs per test, never a shared `setUp` field. Step 3: the body is AAA — arrange the `Money` inputs and a `createMock(DiscountService::class)`, act with a single `calculateTotal(...)` call, assert the returned `Money`. Step 4: the four cases collapse into one `test_calculates_total` method behind `#[DataProvider('totalCases')]`, whose rows are `[items, expectedCents]`. Step 5: `--order-by=random` is run three times and stays green.
example.output: The class runs in ~80 ms because nothing boots; a failure names the offending provider row instead of a file; adding a case is one array line.

example.note: One act, phases separated, mock injected through the constructor, cases in a provider — `aaa-structure`, `mocks-via-di` and `data-provider-table-tests` in one method.
